Our Pricing

Affordable. Honest. Simple.

Starting prices are shown below. Larger or more complicated jobs may require a custom estimate.

Packing Packages

  • Small (1 room)Up to 150 sq ft$125
  • Medium (2–3 rooms)Up to 500 sq ft$225
  • Large (4+ rooms)Up to 1,000 sq ft$325

Clean-Out Services

  • Small spaceCloset, garage, etc.$80
  • Medium spaceRoom, basement, apartment$150
  • Large spaceHouse / large apartment$250+

Loading Services

  • 1/4 truck loadUp to 8 ft.$75
  • 1/2 truck loadUp to 16 ft.$135
  • Full truck loadUp to 26 ft.$200

Extras

  • Heavy itemsEach item$15+
  • Stairs / long carryPer flight / long carry$10+
  • DisassemblyBeds, tables, etc.$20+
  • Boxes & suppliesPer box$2
Important: We do not transport your items. You provide the truck, trailer, or container. Once it's loaded, you take it from there.
